## Summary

- What changed?
- Which backlog IDs or findings does this address?

## Scope boundary

- [ ] Documentation/governance only
- [ ] Application implementation (link to application PR)

## Verification

- [ ] Blocked or skipped checks are explicitly listed
- [ ] Current-state docs and backlog are synchronized

## Evidence and residual risks

List test output/CI links and any known limitation. Do not mark a check passed if it was blocked or not run.
